title: Best Tour Guide Ever!
text: There can be no better tour guide in all of Spain than Mirabel!! She is exceptionally knowledgeable, personable and fun to spend time with, and her English is excellent (she used to teach it, after all)! We could not be more pleased with how we spent our day, and we feel like we have found a new friend!
author: Lyle_M

title: A Must See
text: We were in awe from the beauty of the meticulously cared for gardens to the ancient ruins and castle walls. Our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable and a pleasure to be around !
author: Allison_M

title: Lovely tour
text: Our private tour was amazing and Maribel was an excellent guide. Very knowledgeable about Alhambra and Granada. She also recommended other cool things to do in town.
author: guillopr

title: The Alhambra Experience!
text:
What an amazing tour with Mariabel. Taking in the history, architecture, and sheer scale of the Alhambra is daunting. Yes, we walked our legs off, but Mariabel made the experience both beautiful and memorable.

I could go on about this site where so much history took place, but you've gotta go see it for yourself. Cross your fingers and you and Mariabel may be your guide.

Unforgettable!
author: Timothy_O
